Cabbage Subzi
vegan | 30minute recipe

Nutrition: 
C: 22 | F: 3 | P: 6
Calories: 133 per serving 
Serves 4

Ingredients:
one cabbage, thinly sliced
1 tsp ghee / oil if making this vegan
1 tsp rai (mustard seeds)
1 tsp jeera
1 onion, thinly slices
10-12 curry leaves
1 green chillis 
1 tsp turmeric powder ( haldi)
1 tsp red chilli powder ( can use less if you want a lighter less masala option) 
salt, to taste

Method: 
add the oil to the pan, add in the rai then jeera allow to pop and cook slightly then add in the onion, chilli and curry leaves
once the onions turn translucent, add in the turmeric and red chilli powder, mix together
add in the cabbage and salt to taste
add 1/4 cup water, cover and allow to cook for 10 - 15 minutes till your cabbage is done
